commands_and_keybinds: Crawl: keybind is UNBOUND by default; bind it in Options > Controls.
getting_started: Open Controls and assign a key to Crawl, then use it to crawl.
editor_notes: Whether the key is hold or toggle depends on options; verify in-game. Installed on both sides.
name: Crawl
summary: Lets the player crawl (take the prone/swimming pose) on demand, so you can fit through 1-block-high gaps without needing a trapdoor trick.
